project_workflow_10.en: Save both layouts to this project first.

project_workflow_17.source: 完成评价后，将新结果保存到当前项目。
project_workflow_17.en: Save the new result to the active project after evaluation.

project_workflow_23.en: Choose the reference and candidate layouts from this project.

project_workflow_26.source: 保留原始结果、实验说明和比较条件。
project_workflow_26.en: Keep the original results, study notes and comparison conditions.

project_workflow_32.source: 保存选择不会启动计算。需要调整比较要求时，打开方案对比页并将设置保存回项目。
project_workflow_32.en: Saving selections does not start a calculation. To change requirements, open Compare Layouts and save its settings back to the project.

project_workflow_33.source: 只读访问保留项目的方案选择，不能修改设置。
project_workflow_33.en: Read-only access preserves the project selections and cannot change them.

project_workflow_34.en: Project copies can be viewed independently. New calculations in the tools use the original records and scientific environment currently available on the server.

project_workflow_36.en: This result reuses the exact forward fields prepared during layout evaluation.

project_workflow_37.source: 本结果使用已保存的精确FEM前向场。
project_workflow_37.en: This result uses saved exact FEM forward fields.

project_workflow_38.en: The forward fields for this result were generated by an exact FEM calculation.

project_workflow_39.source: 前向场来源见原始记录。
project_workflow_39.en: See the original record for the forward-field origin.

project_workflow_48.en: The edited copy retains its own evaluation protocol and is not used in fixed 64-position signal simulation.

project_workflow_56.en: Select an experiment to inspect its original metrics and download its scientific copy. Project credentials are saved and shared separately.

project_delivery_1.source: 交付包包含项目说明、已保存的科学副本、方案选择与比较条件，以及记录中的模型、数据和运行环境标识。当前服务端版本另行列出。
project_delivery_1.en: The package contains project notes, saved scientific copies, layout selections, comparison requirements and the recorded model, data and runtime identities. The current server version is listed separately.

project_delivery_2.source: 大型模型数据通过清单和校验值引用，不重复打包。导出不重新计算科学结果。
project_delivery_2.en: Large model data are referenced by their inventory and checksums rather than included again. Export does not recalculate scientific results.
